topic: Schumann 26% aetheric damping — self-contradiction (supremum + globe-formula + hardcoded-monitor)
our_argument_summary: WIN-002 is verdict Self-Contradicted (data/wins.json WIN-002 verdict). Our kill is three-fold: (1) the dome applies the uniform-cavity quarter-wave formula f=c/(4H) while its own H(r)=8537*exp(-r/8619) is exponentially decaying, so any spatial average gives 8.78-35 Hz, never 7.83 Hz (data/wins.json WIN-002 detail_evidence); (2) the 10.59 Hz 'raw theoretical' is Schumann's 1952 SPHERICAL formula f1=(c/2piR)sqrt(2), R=6371 km — a globe number relabelled (detail_evidence, cites Sentman 1990 doi:10.1016/0021-9169(90)90113-2); (3) the supremum theorem: sup H(r)=H(0)=8,537 km, yet the dome claims H(r) reconciles 9,572 km (Schumann inversion) and 9,086 km (model parameterization), both of which exceed the supremum (detail_extra). Monitoring is hardcoded: the dashboard reports predicted==observed==7.83 Hz with no fetch (raw-text/08-live-power.txt Domain 1). This c8 verifies the decider self-apply commit that patched ISS-3063 and ISS-3064 (monitor/decisions/applied-patches/suggested-patches-2026-08-13T06-03.json).

holes_found.description: Two unreconciled radii for Polaris in the SAME field (detail_extra). The ISS-3063 patch (correctly) added the clause 'Only Polaris at 4,750 km is reachable (at r ~ 5,053 km)' to paragraph 1 — 5,053 km is the radius where H(r) equals the claimed Polaris height of 4,750 km. But paragraph 2 (pre-existing, untouched by the patch) still opens 'the sole plausible match — Polaris at r ~ 5,960 km', where 5,960 km is Chapel Hill's radius (the observation location, where the dome states H ~ 4,359 km and direct computation gives 4,274 km). Both numbers are individually correct and describe genuinely different quantities, but the prose never states the distinction, so a reader comparing the two clauses sees the same field assigning Polaris two different radii (5,053 vs 5,960) — which reads as OUR inconsistency rather than the dome's. Not a factual error and does not touch the supremum kill; a coherence/readability nuance sharpened by the otherwise-correct ISS-3063 patch.
holes_found.recommendation: Optional one-clause tie: in detail_extra para1 or at the head of para2, note that r~5,053 km is where H(r) equals the dome's CLAIMED Polaris height (4,750 km) whereas r~5,960 km is Chapel Hill's ACTUAL radius where H(r)~4,274 km — the ~1,000 km gap between 'where the claimed height lives' and 'where the observation lives' is itself further dome self-inconsistency, so connecting them strengthens rather than weakens the argument. Cosmetic; the verdict and both kills stand regardless. Decider MAY file a minor issue or leave as-is.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome is genuinely right that the measured Schumann fundamental (7.83 Hz) sits ~26% below the idealized quarter-wave/globe theoretical value, and that a real physical mechanism accounts for the gap (data/wins.json WIN-002 detail_evidence). That residual is real and non-trivial — it is exactly the finite-conductivity loss that Sentman 1990 (doi:10.1016/0021-9169(90)90113-2) computes from measured ionospheric sigma(h) profiles.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Being right that a 26% residual exists does not make it aetheric: standard ionospheric physics already predicts 7.83 Hz and all five harmonics with no dome geometry (data/wins.json WIN-002 detail_evidence, code_analysis.relabels_standard=true). And the dome's own numbers are mutually exclusive — sup H(r)=8,537 km bars the 9,572 km and 9,086 km heights it claims to reconcile (detail_extra), and the 10.59 Hz it damps from is a spherical-Earth formula (R=6371 km), not a disc derivation. Relabelling a standard-physics residual and then feeding it into a formula that its own geometry violates is why the verdict is Self-Contradicted, not merely Not Demonstrated.
